VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, MAY 20, 2026
  2525 GRAND AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90815
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

Kenneth Osborn, Chair  James Goodin, Commissioner
Antawnette Atkins Blade, Vice Chair  Hershell Hardimon, Commissioner
Jerry Earl, Commissioner  Nicholas Sramek, Commissioner

 Members of the public have the option to email public comments to Veterans@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55135  Recommendation to receive and file opening remarks from the Chair.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55136  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Veterans Affairs Commission
  meeting of Wednesday, January 21, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55151  Recommendation to receive and file a report on the activities of the Office of
  Veterans Support.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55138  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Stand Downs from the
  Department of Veterans Affairs and, if appropriate, provide feedback.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55137  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Veterans Affairs Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, MAY 20, 2026
  2525 GRAND AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90815
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Veterans@longbeach.gov.
